name: CMS
summary: CMS is located at CERN LHC Point 5, Cessy. This general-purpose LHC experiment covers invisible and visible dark-sector signatures.
detection_principle: Tracking, calorimetry and muon systems seek missing transverse momentum, displaced dilepton decays and semivisible jets. These signatures test different models and cannot be combined into a universal mass-exclusion line.

results.summary: A nonresonant strongly coupled dark-matter search found no significant excess and constrained semivisible-jet models.
A low-momentum displaced-electron-pair search found no significant signal and constrained the electron channel of inelastic dark matter.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
